title: Rule 7 mixed link-local vector encodes one endpoint as IID under full mode
description: schc_adaptation.json rule7_noncanonical_link_local_full_mode_valid uses source fe90:: and destination fe80::. Normative Rule 7 has one AddressMode bit: because both are not in canonical fe80::/64, AddressMode=1 and both 128-bit addresses must be full. The vector correctly labels the source full but incorrectly labels destination_encoding=link_local_iid, contradicting its name/provenance/spec and enabling asymmetric noncanonical consumers. Set both to full and make Python/Rust consumers assert the single shared mode.
